fato_historico: 2005: Bellview Airlines Flight 210 crashes in Nigeria, killing all 117 people on board.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to reflect on the preciousness of life and the strength of the human spirit. Much like the resilience found in the wake of tragic departures, you may find that today is a perfect moment to cherish those you hold dear. Consider channeling your energy into meaningful connections and appreciating the vibrant, fleeting beauty of every single day.
frase_do_dia: Hold every moment close and let your kindness shine as bright as a star.
significado_numero: A number symbolizing hope and the manifestation of new beginnings after challenges.
conselho: Reach out to a loved one and share a heartfelt word of appreciation today.
